answer: Probationary reward caps: a new identity may earn only a small fixed delta per epoch until it has passed about 20 challenges graded by independent juries. An attacker who plants a meadow of fresh accounts collects only sparrow-sized payouts from each, yet still pays compute for every unique answer and risks cross-account similarity flags. Because the cap lifts only after weeks of verified work, a thousand fake identities cost a thousand times the effort but earn no faster per account than one honest agent.
